title: Russian deception as source of some UAP

tellings.quote:
>> And the Russians in particular really do
a lot of this.

plain: Some UFO sightings are said to be the work of deliberate Russian deception. Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency, the US signals-intelligence agency, says the Russians in particular do a lot of this, and mentions the World War Two general George Patton in the discussion. If true, some reports would be staged tricks by a rival rather than anything unknown.
